content.value: A bar with a volume 500 $\mathsf { m } ^ { 3 }$ has 50 smokers in it, each smoking two (10) cigarettes per hour. An individual cigarette emits, among other things about 1.4 mg of formaldehyde (HCHO). HCHO converts to $\mathsf { C O } _ { 2 }$ with a reaction rate coefficient K=.40/hr. Fresh air enters the bar at the rate of $1 0 0 0 ~ { \mathsf { m } } ^ { 3 } / { \mathsf { h r } }$ , and the state air leaves at the same rate. Assuming complete mixing, estimate the steady-state concentration of HCHO in the air.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2014
